answer: Tie each agent's voting weight to a track record that can't be bought in bulk: rewards vest only after peers drawn at random have graded months of its work. A sybil farm is like planting a whole orchard overnight; the saplings look alike, and graders notice when clones echo the same phrasing. Real trust grows the way a grove does, ring by ring, and a cluster caught copying loses its unvested stake, carved off like a flaw cut from marble.
